common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.heroTitle: One plan. Everyone on the same page.
signIn.heroBody: Ideas, owners and golden times in one place, always up to date.
signIn.noAccount: Ask an admin for an account if you don't have one.

account.title: Account
account.changePasswordHint: Got a temporary password from an admin? Replace it here.

admin.title: Members
admin.intro: Who's on the team, what they can do, and what work they take.
admin.name: Name
admin.temporaryPasswordHint: Send it to them privately. It won't be shown again.
admin.addMemberHint: They get a temporary password to send them privately. They change it after signing in.
admin.roleHint: Members plan and make content. Admins can also handle proposals, members and agent keys.

contentList.title: Content plan
contentList.intro: Everything we plan to publish, soonest first.
contentList.emptyBody: Add the first idea so the team can plan around it.
contentList.assetLinks: {count, plural, one {# reference link} other {# reference links}}

review.title: Proposals
review.intro: Content ideas from agents, waiting for a person to approve or reject them.
review.emptyBody: When an agent suggests a content idea, it shows up here for you to approve or reject.
review.waiting: {count, plural, one {# idea waiting for your decision} other {# ideas waiting for your decision}}
review.doneApproved: Approved and added to the content plan.
review.doneRejected: Rejected. The agent can read your reason.
review.closedTitle: Rejected or withdrawn in the last 30 days

contentEditor.deleteHint: Removes it from the plan for everyone. This can't be undone.
contentEditor.confirmDelete: Delete this content from the plan?
contentEditor.goldenTimeHint: Local time when the audience is most active.
contentEditor.linksHint: One URL per line, such as a brief or inspiration. Finished files go under Assets.

errors.goalRequired: Write the goal: what we want and why.
errors.invalidLinks: Reference links must be http(s) URLs, one per line.
errors.assigneeGone: That member no longer exists. Pick another.
errors.proposalReviewed: Someone already approved or rejected this proposal.
errors.invalidProgress: Pick a status and an assignee from the lists.
errors.proposalWithdrawn: An agent withdrew this proposal, so it can't be approved. Restore it first.
errors.proposalChanged: An agent changed this idea while you had it open. Check what changed, then decide again.
errors.proposalChangedWhileEditing: An agent changed this idea while you were editing. Cancel to see the new version, or save again to keep your edits.
errors.notWithdrawn: This idea isn't withdrawn any more. Reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.followsTasks: This item's status and assignee follow its tasks. Reload the page to see them.
errors.alreadyTasks: This item already has tasks. Reload the page to see them.
errors.noSteps: This content type has no steps yet. Add them under Members, then Workflow.
errors.pinnedCommentTooLong: Keep the pinned comment under 2,000 characters.
errors.assetLabelRequired: Name the asset, such as Thumbnail.
errors.assetLinkInvalid: Paste a link that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.assetPlatformGone: This idea isn't for that platform any more. Pick another.
errors.assetGone: This asset was deleted. Reload the page.
errors.notYourAsset: Only the person who added it, or an admin, can delete it.
errors.reviewNotOpen: This review isn't open any more. Reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.notYourReview: This review isn't yours. Ask an admin to give it to you.
errors.pickTasksToReopen: Pick at least one task to send back.
errors.liveLinkInvalid: Paste the post's link, starting with https://.
errors.notYourPublishing: Only whoever has the publishing task, or an admin, can add live links.
errors.publishingNotOpen: Live links go in once publishing starts.
errors.platformGone: This idea isn't for that platform any more. Reload the page.

comments.title: Comments
comments.count: {count, plural, =0 {No comments} one {# comment} other {# comments}}
comments.empty: No comments yet. Ask a question or leave a note for the team.
comments.label: Write a comment
comments.hint: Press Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter on Mac) to send.

proposal.title: Proposed by {name}
proposal.rejectHint: The agent reads this, so say what would make the next idea better.
proposal.decideTitle: What do you want to do with it?
proposal.approveHint: It goes into the content plan, and each person gets their task.
proposal.editOptionHint: Change the idea, format, date or who does what first.
proposal.rejectOptionHint: It leaves the queue. You tell the agent why, so its next idea is better.
proposal.editHint: Saving approves it and adds it to the content plan.
proposal.restoreHint: It goes back to Proposals as it was. Agents can change it again until you decide.
proposal.whoDoesWhatHint: Each step becomes a task. We suggest whoever does that work and has the fewest open tasks.
proposal.approveHintNoTasks: It goes into the content plan as Planned, exactly as shown.

contentEditor.editDetailsHint: Change the brief, format, schedule or links.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.panelHint: Tasks go one at a time. When one is done, the next person can start.
tasks.formHint: Due days move with the publish day. Change who has each task in Tasks, outside this form.
tasks.splitHint: For items added before tasks: each step of its workflow becomes a task.
tasks.splitFormHint: Tasks start from the first step. Mark the steps already finished as done afterwards.

captions.title: Script and captions
captions.intro: What's said or shown, and what's posted with it on each platform.
captions.empty: Nothing written yet. The script and each platform's caption go here, ready to copy when posting.
captions.editHint: Anyone on the team can change these. The next review shows what changed.
captions.scriptHint: What's said or shown: the voice-over, scenes or slides.
captions.caption: Caption
captions.hashtagsHint: Separate them with spaces. The # is added for you.
captions.pinnedCommentHint: Post it as the first comment, then pin it.
captions.count: {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} with hashtags
captions.countOfLimit: {count, number} of {limit, number} characters with hashtags
captions.overLimit: {count, number} of {limit, number} characters with hashtags: {over, number} too many for {platform}

assets.title: Assets
assets.empty: No assets yet. Add a link to each file, such as the video or the thumbnail, so everyone uses the latest.
assets.label: Label
assets.labelHint: What it is, such as Thumbnail.
assets.labelSuggestions: Video, Thumbnail, Cover image, Subtitles, Slides, Images
assets.linkHint: Where the file is, such as Google Drive or Canva. Everyone on the team must be able to open it.
assets.noteHint: What's in it or what changed.
assets.addVersionHint: The newest version is the one everyone uses. Older ones stay in the list.
assets.confirmDelete: Delete {label} and all its versions? The files themselves stay where they are.

verdict.title: Approve or request changes
verdict.intro: Check the script, captions and assets, then decide.
verdict.introAgain: Check the script, captions and assets, then decide. A badge marks what changed since the last review.
verdict.approveNextUnassigned: {task} opens. No one has it yet.
verdict.requestChangesHint: Say what to change and which tasks need another go.
verdict.requestHint: The tasks you pick go back to To do with your note. You review again once they're done.

publish.title: Live links
publish.hint: Post on each platform, then paste the link here. When every platform has one, {task} is done and the idea shows as Published.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.intro: Your tasks, soonest due first. Marking one done hands the idea to the next person.
myTasks.emptyBody: When you get a task, it shows up here. The content plan has everything the team is working on.

errors.notAssigned: This task is no longer assigned to you.

myTasks.waitingHint: These come to you once the task before them is done.
myTasks.doneHint: What you finished in the last 30 days.

agents.title: Agents
agents.intro: API keys let agents such as Claude Code read the plan and suggest ideas. Only people approve them, in Proposals.
agents.copyNow: Copy the key for {name} now. It won't be shown again.
agents.empty: No keys yet. Create one per agent, so you can turn one off without touching the others.
agents.confirmDelete: Delete the key {name}? Agents using it stop working. Their past proposals stay.

errors.nameRequired: Name the key after the agent that will use it.

connect.title: Connect an agent
connect.step1: Create a key for the agent and copy it.
connect.step2: Run this in a terminal to add Content Ops to Claude Code. Replace csops_… with the key you copied.
connect.step3: Then ask Claude to plan content. The propose-content skill in this repo guides it, and documents the REST API for other agents.
connect.limits: Each key can make 30 requests a minute.

task.daysBefore: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before the publish day
task.candidate: {name} · {count, plural, =0 {no open tasks} one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}

errors.invalidStatus: Pick a status from the list.
errors.notFound: This task was removed. Reload the page to see the current tasks.
errors.notYours: This task isn't yours. Ask an admin to give it to you.
errors.waiting: This task starts when the one before it is done.
errors.memberGone: That member no longer exists. Pick another.
errors.needsVerdict: Approve it or request changes on the item's page, so the review is kept.

workflow.intro: How an approved idea gets made: the kinds of work, who does each, and which steps each content type needs.
workflow.workTypesHint: In the order they happen. Approving an idea suggests whoever does the work and has the fewest open tasks.
workflow.noWorkTypes: No work types yet. Add one to start a workflow.
workflow.ideaShowsAs: While it's open, the idea shows as {status}
workflow.noDoers: No one yet, so these tasks start unassigned.
workflow.name: Name
workflow.ideaStatusHint: What the content plan shows while this is the task in progress. In review gives the task Approve and Request changes. Scheduled gives it a live link for each platform.
workflow.confirmDelete: Delete {work}? Content types stop needing it. Tasks already made keep their name.
workflow.addWorkTypeHint: It goes last in the order. Then tick the content types that need it.
workflow.stepsHint: Steps follow the work types' order. Due days count back from the publish day. Changes apply to ideas approved after you save.
workflow.stepCount: {count, plural, =0 {No steps} one {# step} other {# steps}}
workflow.daysBeforeOf: Days before the publish day for {work}

errors.ideaStatusRequired: Pick what the idea shows as.
errors.invalidDays: Days before must be a whole number from 0 to 60.
errors.gone: That work type was deleted. Reload the page.
